title: WP900 G9 must isolate broadcast-content causality from pre-broadcast competition and selection state
target: F2-WP-900 generation 9 semantic content causality crossover

material_observation.g9_strength: G9 correctly moves from broadcast-present versus no-broadcast to same-mechanism semantic-content crossover and already has reviewer fences for evaluator blindness, payload identity leakage, non-GWT side channels, representation equivalence and inter-trial carryover.
material_observation.remaining_confound: If semantic A/B exists in candidate, competition, workspace or selection state before the admitted broadcast is emitted, treatment has already occurred upstream of the mediator. A later semantic outcome can then be caused by pre-broadcast selection/competition effects while the same A/B payload also traverses valid DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY. This can pass a same-mechanism crossover yet fail to identify broadcast-mediated semantic content as the cause.
material_observation.why_distinct: The existing non-GWT side-channel fence targets parallel treatment paths visible to the executor. This packet targets an earlier treatment-time violation inside the GWT pipeline itself: treatment-correlated competition/selection/workspace state may causally influence downstream behavior before the broadcast mediator under test begins.

falsifier_hypothesis: To claim broadcast-content causality, the semantic treatment must be introduced at a preregistered post-selection intervention boundary or pre-broadcast treatment-dependent state must be proven causally inert for the measured outcome. Otherwise the experiment identifies a broader candidate-selection-plus-broadcast treatment, not semantic broadcast mediation.

counterexample.setup: A and B candidates differ semantically before selection. Competition or winner selection writes treatment-correlated workspace/control state. Both selected payloads then traverse identical DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY and a treatment-blind observer sees stable A/B outcomes.
counterexample.bad_behavior: Disable or neutralize the semantic payload at the broadcast boundary while leaving the treatment-correlated pre-broadcast selection state intact. If the A/B outcome difference persists, the observed effect was not isolated to broadcast semantic content.

preferred_intervention: Freeze identical candidate/competition/selection/pre-broadcast workspace state, then inject semantic A versus B only at an explicit post-selection broadcast-payload intervention boundary.
Bind the pre-intervention state digest, selected slot/envelope identity, selection receipt and intervention point before treatment bytes are introduced.
Require DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY lineage from the post-selection treatment-bearing broadcast to the blinded downstream outcome.
fallback_if_post_selection_injection_is_: Bind all treatment-correlated pre-broadcast state and execute a mediator-disable or payload-neutralization control while preserving that upstream state.
If the downstream A/B effect survives removal/neutralization of semantic content at the broadcast boundary, classify upstream/pre-broadcast causality rather than semantic broadcast causality.
If upstream state cannot be observed or held equivalent, preserve UNKNOWN for broadcast-specific semantic mediation.
hard_negatives: A/B selection or competition state differs before the declared semantic intervention point -> BROAD_TREATMENT_NOT_BROADCAST_ISOLATED
payload-neutralized broadcast retains A/B outcome difference -> PREBROADCAST_OR_PARALLEL_CAUSAL_PATH
selected candidate identity or workspace winner metadata reaches downstream control before broadcast uptake -> MEDIATOR_TEMPORAL_ORDER_VIOLATION
pre-broadcast state digest omits treatment-relevant workspace/selection/control fields -> PRESTATE_SCOPE_INCOMPLETE
valid DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY co-occurs with an earlier treatment-dependent causal path -> GWT_PATH_PRESENT_BUT_MEDIATION_UNPROVEN

promotion_rule: G9 may earn only the narrowest treatment scope supported by executed evidence. Semantic-content candidate credit must distinguish candidate/selection treatment from post-selection broadcast-content treatment. Semantic GWT/J-Space broadcast-mediated promotion remains zero unless treatment timing and mediator ordering are independently bound and a pre-broadcast causal alternative is excluded or neutralized.
next_exact_action: Do not duplicate or mutate G9 from this reviewer lane. The active owner should either introduce A/B only after an equivalent selection state, or add an executable payload-neutralization/mediator control that falsifies pre-broadcast competition/selection causality before any broadcast-specific semantic GWT promotion.
